_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.src: Y'see, I got a few things here... look around for a bit, they're all very rare...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.src: I see that look in yer eyes... Ya interested in something here? It's all 'fa sale...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.src: ..Say, humie... I ain't mean to alarm ya, but do ya know who that guy sneakin' up behind 'ye is?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.src: OI! Wake up, you damned miscreant!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.src: Took ya long enough.. Alright, listen up, maggot!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.src: We found ya outside of {p}, passed out near some dead body, and... Well, we had to arrest someone for that merchant's death!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.src: And don't think you get to just lounge around all day in your cell. You gotta do work here, or you're getting thrown in the hole.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.src: But for now, you’re stayin’ in your cell, understood? Now, stay here, and take a look around your cell. You'll know when it's time to work..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.src: GWAH! Who the hell are you?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#011.src: Oh, thank grook, you're just another prisoner... So young, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#011.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.src: You just got here, right? Well... I can tell you're innocent... Just like almost everyone else in this forsaken prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.src: Listen, human... This prison... You couldn't have come to a more horrific prison in the entire world! This place is hellish!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.src: The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.src: I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.src: Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.src: Are you sure, uh, sir? I don't think I'm supposed to be anywhere today...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.src: Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.src: H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.src: OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.src: It’s work time, filth. I'll escort you to the hallways. Once you're there, someone will tell you what to do. Do as they say, and you might come back tonight.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.src: You got that, wretch? Alright, now get out of your cell!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.src: Get your instructions from the guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.src: Guess you're the one on cleanin' duty, huh? Alright. Listen up, scum!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.src: Take this sponge, and look around the hallways. If you see a mess, use the sponge to clean it up. Someone will escort you back to the cells once you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.src: Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.src: Search the hallways for messes to clean up

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.src: Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.src: You're done cleaning? Alright, it's time for rollcall. You're being escorted back to the cell block. Follow me, and don't move.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#030.src: Well, well, well... Looks like the dross of society is here on time!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#030.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.src: Alright. Stay in line, and don't move, maggots! It's time for roll call...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.src: You’re all here… Ha! That’s a surprise, you outcasts can actually follow orders!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#034.src: ...Hm… Looks like we’ve got a new arrival too.. Don’t worry, peon... your soul will be well secure here for the rest of eternity.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#034.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.src: Alright. That’s it for now, you worthless menaces. It’s meal time. Head to the cafeteria, and pray that we’re not giving you your last meal.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.src: Find a place to sit in the cafeteria

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.src: Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.src: I'm... starving to death here... those blasted guards won't... let me get any food...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.src: Please... to my right... There's some food sitting there, if you could get it for me, I'd be... eternally grateful...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.src: I... I can't thank you enough, human... I should be able to keep going with this...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#042.src: Say... if you ever get out of this slaughterhouse... could you go to {p}... and try and talk with my family, there? Let them know that I'm still alive...? I'd appreciate that....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#042.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.src: Hey.. It's alright, you can sit here, don't worry.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.src: So... you're new here, right? Hah… Guessing you're innocent, just like the rest of us… and I mean that...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.src: He's tellin' the truth, new guy. Most of us here are just average civilians. I worked at a transportation company in {p}, and was delivering some crates to {p} when they snatched me just out of town.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.src: Me too! I don't even know why I was put here at all! I wasn't even given a trial in court, or anything! They just plucked me off the streets and threw me in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.src: They wanna kill you, that's why. Did ya hear about Revan? He got taken away a couple of days ago, after he accidentally stumbled during roll call. Nobody's heard or seen 'em since.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.src: I… you're probably right... I just dont understand any of this anymore... I just want to escape this damn place for good...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.src: ...Good luck with that.. Only way out is through that exit door, and even then you gotta get into the Control Room, as well. It's...just impossible, y'know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.src: Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.src: ...Well… That's this place in a nutshell for you, human. Just try not to get in anyone's way or step out of line, and you should be alright until they end up taking you.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.src: Oi, who’s this guy right ‘ere? We don’t know ya. Move it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.src: ‘Ey, ‘ey, let it rest, Don. They're not hurtin’ nobody.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.src: Don’t worry about it. So... You know who we are, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#056.src: We’re part of the Placido Crime Family. We do business across the entire world; all parts of it, you know what I’m saying?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#056.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.src: Almost all of us at this table got caught for running with the family-... Ah, bet you’re surprised to hear that there are some guilty people up in this slaughterhouse, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.src: It’s alright, you don’t have to worry about us getting plucked and killed like those other piacevole here. Guards keep on sayin’ something about “our souls are too tainted”, whatever they mean.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.src: Hah! Maybe you’ll get the same treatment too, novello. I saw it the minute I laid eyes on ya. You’re a killer too, ain't ya? Hey, gotta be one to know you're dealin' with one..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.src: ..Anyways... You thinkin’ about staying in this prison, fratello? Word of advice: Don’t. If you can, you gotta escape. You might think it’s impossible for someone to escape here, or whatnot...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.src: Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.src: But no, you're different. I can see it in those eyes. You just gotta find a way into that Control Room, somehow. And hey, if you do get outta here, go and raise some hell in the Levtus Black Market for us, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.src: Alright, look straight, scum! Morning rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.src: ...you’re all here...? Hm... Disappointing, honestly. Rollcall is over. All of you, head to wherever your job is, and get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.src: Search the hallways for possible escape routes, and find a guard outfit

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#068.src: Report to the Prison Guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.src: You're done? Alright, now follow me. Rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.src: What with you all, showing up late like this?? It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.src: You're all here, huh? Alright then, head on to dinn-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.src: Oi! Quit steppin' on my shoes, cretino!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.src: Hey! What the hell are you talkin' about, making up something like that! I didn't do anythin'!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#074.src: Shut it, fat-nose! You know what you were doin'! Now stay out of my way!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#074.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.src: OI! Are you blind, or something?!? Get those lowlifes under control, guards!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.src: You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.src: W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.src: LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.src: You two really are stupid, huh? Fighting in the midst of all of these guards? And you got a shank, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.src: Well, looks like it's game over for you two outcasts. You're heading straight to the hole!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.src: You, take these two cretins to the hole, and you, go to my office and get one of the spare control room keys. Now, LIGHTS OUT!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.src: Alright, everyone get in line, and stand straight! Don't move, or it's game over for you!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.src: H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.src: Well, well, well... Another peon thought it was wise to step off course..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.src: W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#086.src: BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#086.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.src: Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.src: Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#089.src: Find a way to open the exit door

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.src: Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.src: Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.src: Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.src: Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.src: Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.src: Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.src: I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.src: Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#100.src: Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#100.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.src: Find and destroy your criminal records

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.src: Who are you? Can I help you, human?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.src: WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.src: I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.src: Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.src: M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.src: ...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.src: The only way to escape is by heading through the exit door. You'll need to access the control room in order to open it...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#110.src: The Prison appears to be lying about almost everything they do to the government, and they appear to buy into it, despite all the rumors about this place.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.src: It looks like the only way to get out of here is through the exit door..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.src: Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin to ya here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.src: So, welcome to the {p}. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.src: There's a dusty key inside, labeled "SUPPLY CLOSETS"

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.src: Some water came out of the shower head.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.speaker: Grook

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.src: Looks like there's an inmate being interrogated...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#122.src: It's blocked off, though the holes in the fence are wide enough for you to get something through...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#123.src: This must be the exit door..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#124.src: It appears to be completely locked.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#125.src: There's some stuff on the table. It looks like... flesh??

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#126.src: You bite back the urge to vomit... was this once a person???

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#127.src: The book is titled 'A GUIDE TO SOUL EXTRACTION'.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#128.src: It'd probably be best not to touch it..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#129.src: There's some broken bits and pieces of a torture device here..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#130.src: The blade is rusted and completely stained with dried blood..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#132.src: There's some cheese inside of the crate.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#133.src: This must be the warden's office...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#134.src: The warden seems very engrossed in her writing..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#135.src: You place the cheese on the floor, where the rat had run by...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#136.src: Looks like the rat dropped something when it ran away...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#137.src: You managed to fill your bucket with some water.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#138.src: You throw the water bucket onto the generator...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#139.src: Looks like something popped out of the generator...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#140.src: Looks like you've cleaned up all the messes! You should return to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're done.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#141.src: You're escorted back to the cell block by the guard...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#142.src: The two of you arrive just as rollcall is about to begin. Some guards shove you into place with the other prisoners...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#143.src: You're escorted to the cafeteria by the guards...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.src: You're escorted out of the cafeteria and back to your cell...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.speaker: Grook

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#145.src: Looks like that's the end of today... Your top priority tomorrow should be to devise a plan to escape the prison. Finding a guard outfit could be helpful, as well..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#145.speaker: Grook

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#146.src: [{~}/{~}] ??? Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!

similar.text: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#147.src: There's a lockpicking kit inside of this crate!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#148.src: There's a few stacks of coins inside of this crate.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#149.src: There are some vegetables inside of this crate.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#150.src: This must be the exit door.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#151.src: This should be the most direct way out of the prison... You'll need to get into the control room to open it, though.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#152.src: It's the map of the prison's hallways.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#154.src: Looks like the Warden isn't here during your regular work time... That could be useful later on...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#155.src: This must be the control room those inmates were talking about yesterday...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#156.src: This room has to be your ticket out of this place. You just need to find a way inside of it...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#157.src: You vaguely remember the rat that had ran by here yesterday...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#158.src: You put the guard uniform underneath your regular outfit. This should help you avoid some suspicion when you make your escape...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#159.src: Looks like this is all you'll be able to find for now. You should head back to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're finished working.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#161.src: Time to take stock of the situation. You need to get out of here, and you might just have found enough out to do it.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#162.src: The Warden mentioned during rollcall that there's spare control room keys in her office. You'll have to find a way into her office during work time in order to access the control room.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.src: Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over fo-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#164.src: -The hell? Ow, hey! Get off me, you worthless pests!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.src: ...All of you... Get out... Of my sight... NOW.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#166.src: Now that the guard isn't standing here, you can more closely inspect this vent...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#167.src: It looks quite old, and the vent grates appear to be splitting at their seams... it shouldn't take too much effort to just...?

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#168.src: Perfect! With the grate off, it's relatively easy to squeeze through the vent opening.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#169.src: These papers on the desk appear to be directed to the Warden.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#170.src: The papers appear to be asking the Warden for...? A quota of souls...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.src: The signature at the end simply reads the letter D.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#172.src: There are some books stacked up in piles right here.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#173.src: The subject of the books range from the history of the Decay, to spirit magic and... Soul extraction.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#174.src: It'd probably be best to stop looking through these.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#175.src: The key fits perfectly into the door's keyhole...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#176.src: There are some papers here about the prison's history..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#177.src: The papers say that the prison was constructed in {~} AP, and was reserved for Gavel's worst criminals...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#178.src: It's also the largest prison in all of Gavel, and receives an enormous amount of funding in order to maintain captivity of their inmates...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#180.src: It's just instructions on how to operate electromagic appliances.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#181.src: There are a few rusted axe heads in here. The sharp edges are stained with dried blood...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#182.src: The screen appears to show a map of the entire prison! It looks like after you head through the exit door, you'll have to sneak through a large portion of the prison to escape.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#183.src: Near the back of the prison, there's a room that holds almost all of the records in the prison... You might be able to destroy your criminal record if you reach it!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#184.src: There's a lever on this control panel that is labeled with the words "UNLOCK EXIT DOOR".

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#185.src: You can hear the sound of a door opening in the distance... the exit door must have just opened!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#186.src: This screen appears to show some information about guard patrols and placements in the second half of the prison...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#187.src: ...The entire area is going to be crawling with guards. You're going to have to sneak through them all in order to escape the prison for good.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#188.src: There's some extremely dark looking metal inside of this closet. You can't tell what it's used for...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#189.src: This cabinet has a number of letters between Gavel's government and the Prison.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#190.src: The government must not care about the lives of anyone who lives in Gavel's northern forests enough to condemn the prison for all of this slaughter.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#191.src: These cabinets have some criminal records on a lot of the prisoners here...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#192.src: Most of these files are virtually empty, save for a select few that had committed petty thefts some time ago.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#193.src: This box has a few criminal records in here. The first one has your name on it... At least you didn't need to search very long to find it.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#194.src: There should be something nearby you can use to destroy it.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#195.src: You toss your criminal records into the fire. Good riddance.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#196.src: Your record has been destroyed, for now. You can finally leave the prison for good.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#197.src: This cabinet has a few records on the Warden...but they all seem incomplete.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#198.src: Hardly any of the information is actually filled out, No age, career history, family, or any other information. She appears to be a complete un-person.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#199.src: It's as if she just popped into existence for the sole purpose of being this prison's warden.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.src: There you are! Good to see you managed to escape that horrid place!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.speaker: Kaetan

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.src: But seriously, thank you, {u}. I thought I was going to get killed in there! This isn't much, but hopefully it can help you get back on your feet after all of that.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.speaker: Kaetan

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#202.src: Anyways, I have to go now. But if I can ever help you with anything at all, just let me know! I'm forever in your debt, human.
